roi: Live/dead union-object mask, dilated by one pixel, excluding pixels assigned to another object.
statistic: Sum of unchanged original EBFP pixel values within ROI.
local_null: Same mask translated by all valid integer offsets with 18 <= displacement <= 65 pixels, excluding placements overlapping any object mask dilated by two pixels.
empirical_p: (1 + number of null sums >= observed sum)/(1 + number of null placements). Conservative ties included.
classification: Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across all 1297 objects in S5/S6/S7; q <= 0.05.
interpretation: Detectable EBFP-channel enrichment relative to local cell-free background. Exploratory empirical criterion; no biological specificity or sensitivity established without controls; does not measure ongoing protein synthesis.
validation: Mask dilation 0/1/2 pixels, q thresholds 0.01/0.025/0.05/0.10, and a computational 35-pixel horizontal shift of blue-channel coordinates scored at the fixed unshifted p cutoff; source images remain unmodified. The shift is a spatial-association null, not a biological negative control.
randomness: None. All valid local shifts evaluated exhaustively.
